connector.name: Salesforce Marketing
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Salesforce - 47 tools for leads, campaigns, pipeline, attribution, and reporting.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package salesforce-marketing-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the zleventer account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.description: Login URL — use https://test.salesforce.com for sandbox (default https://login.salesforce.com)
